newsitem.title: USA: Fix-Corp recycling line at full production.
newsitem.headline: Fix-Corp recycling line at full production.

text.p: Fix-Corp International Inc said on Tuesday that plastic recycling line 2 at its FIXCOR Industries unit is operating full time around the clock, seven days a week.
This is the second line brought to full time production since Fix-Corp International launched the plastic recycling division on January 8, 1997, the company said.
The plastic that is currently being processed is sold, and it is anticipated that the revenues from the two lines will translate into $10,000,000 for a 12 month period, the company said.
